trajectory_summary: This is a steady, cooperative call that moved from a confusing internal transfer into a workmanlike verify-and-book sequence. The rep captured the address, roof, utility, and a bill range, handled an unusual multi-building/multi-meter property with reasonable transparency, and locked a specific day, time, and location for an in-person appointment. The main soft spots are an under-explored Tesla expectation gap and a bill amount that was captured but never flipped into urgency.
